articles.title: $51 billion for peace? Houthis' hefty terms for ceasefire with Saudi Arabia
articles.description: The Houthis demanded USD 51 billion and recognition as Yemen's rulers after Saudi Arabia sought to halt renewed attacks. The ultimatum deepens Riyadh's military dilemma as the rebels advance towards Aden and target vital infrastructure.
